children.value: > Fact From Story: If tensions escalate bond yields might decline further because they’re a safe haven, but equities would sell off in that instance because of increased uncertainty and risk aversion

> Fact From Story: Concerns about the conflict spreading more broadly have eased amid growing calls within Israel to rethink a ground invasion of Gaza because of fears about the fate of some 200 hostages held there, the danger of retaliation by Hezbollah and the risk of Israeli military casualties.
> > Fact From Story: Besides Gaza, clashes have already been ongoing along Israel’s borders with Syria and Lebanon.
> > > Fact From Story: If Iran gets dragged into the conflict, on account of claims of funding Hamas, this could embroil the entire Middle East in crisis.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Syria and Lebanon border Israel. | Commonsense Knowledge

> > Fact From Story: A massive strike by Israel in Gaza, potentially killing civilians in collateral damage, may attract more of the Middle East countries, including the de-facto leader Saudi Arabia to raise serious issues against Israel on humanitarian grounds.
> > > Fact From Story: If Iran gets dragged into the conflict, on account of claims of funding Hamas, this could embroil the entire Middle East in crisis.
> > > Fact From Story: Besides Gaza, clashes have already been ongoing along Israel’s borders with Syria and Lebanon.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Syria and Lebanon are countries in the Middle East.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Syria and Lebanon are countries in the Middle East.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Escalated tensions can cause a conflict to spread.
